neighbours.label: the requestee slot after the verb 'ask': 'ask your/his X' and the 'to' that follows (ask your doctor to…); other request verbs fire weakly
fire: When the bill looks too high, ask your landlord to explain each charge.
After the lesson, ask your coach to show the move again.
If the form is confusing, ask your accountant to fill it in.
At the pharmacy, ask your chemist to print a larger label.
Before surgery, ask your surgeon to describe the recovery.
On the first day, ask your manager to introduce the team.
If the essay feels weak, ask your tutor to mark the draft.
When travelling abroad, ask your bank to raise the card limit.
quiet: When the bill looks too high, your landlord should explain each charge.
After the lesson, your coach will show the move again.
If the form is confusing, your accountant can fill it in.
At the pharmacy, thank your chemist for printing a larger label.
Before surgery, they asked whether the recovery would be long.
On the first day, tell your manager about the earlier project.
If the essay feels weak, your tutor may mark the draft.
When travelling abroad, visit your bank and raise the card limit.

notes: Card: ' your' x13, ' to' x5, ' his' x3, all after ask/asked (one 'telling Alexa to'). Probes: ask your X to 0.50-0.58, asked his 0.37, ask a friend to 0.40; told/reminded/begged 0.14-0.21; 'your doctor' without ask 0.01; 'asked whether' 0.03.
